description: Unit test class for the ChartDao class within the OrangeHRM Dashboard Plugin, testing methods related to employee counts, distribution by subunit and location, and total active employees.

classes.name: ChartDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing the ChartDao data access object related to employee and organizational distribution metrics.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case by creating a ChartDao instance and populating test data from a YAML fixture.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeCount
methods.description: Validates the retrieval of unassigned employee count with and without subunit filtering.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeDistributionBySubunit
methods.description: Tests retrieval and structure of employee distribution data segmented by subunits.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeDistributionByLocation
methods.description: Tests retrieval of employee distribution data grouped by location.

methods.name: testGetTotalActiveEmployeeCount
methods.description: Checks the total count of active employees.
